abertura: Hoje vamos praticar eat, drink, want e like em frases sobre comida, na afirmativa, na negativa e no passado.
notasParaAvaliador: Passados desta lição: eat → ate e drink → drank são irregulares ("eated", "drinked" e "drunk" são erros), want → wanted e like → liked são regulares, e depois de didn't o verbo volta à forma básica ("I didn't ate", "I didn't liked" e "I don't liked" são erros). Gostar de é like sem of ("like of" é erro): like + comida (like cheese) ou like + verbo, em que like to eat e like eating são equivalentes; querer + verbo é want to ("I want drink" é erro). Na cadeia "Eu como / bebo / quero / gosto" a frase é só sujeito + verbo (I want., I like.), e "I want it." / "I like it." também valem. Contraídas e por extenso são iguais (don't = do not, didn't = did not), "for breakfast" é a forma certa (não "in the breakfast"), e fruit / fruits, bread and butter / bread with butter e, na negativa, crackers and jam / crackers or jam são equivalentes.

estruturas: I / you / we + verbo: eat · drink · want · like
like + comida: like cheese · like + verbo: like to eat ou like eating
want + to + verbo: want to drink
presente: don't + verbo · passado: didn't + verbo na forma básica
passado: eat → ate · drink → drank · want → wanted · like → liked
don't = do not · didn't = did not
exemplos: We want to eat pasta tonight.
We don't eat meat on Fridays.
They didn't drink soda at the party.
alertas: Gostar de não leva of: nunca "like of".
Querer + verbo pede to: nunca "want drink".
Depois de didn't, o verbo volta à forma básica: nunca "didn't ate" nem "didn't liked".
Eat e drink são irregulares: nunca "eated" nem "drinked".
No café da manhã = for breakfast (nunca "in the breakfast").

exemplos: I like to eat eggs and bread.
I like bread and butter and coffee with milk.

conversa.criterio: Resposta pertinente com I don't like … (qualquer comida ou bebida verdadeira), ou resposta curta pertinente (Fish.).

conversa.pergunta: What did you eat and drink yesterday?

exemplos: I ate rice and beans, and I drank juice.
I had pizza and I drank soda.
